properties.name: Crib Goch & Garnedd Ugain Knife-Edge Ridge
properties.plainSummary: Exposed Grade 1 knife-edge ridge with 300m sheer drops on both sides. Lethal in high winds or ice.
properties.primaryMetric: MREW High-Frequency Terrain Cluster | 923m–1,085m | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Unroped scrambling with severe fall exposure. Avoid in gusts >30 mph, cloud, or winter verglas; use Llanberis or Ranger path.

properties.name: Yr Wyddfa East Face / Clogwyn y Garnedd Sheer Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Vertical 250m cliff face directly below Snowdon summit & Pyg/Miners upper zig-zags.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 250m Vertical Drop & Winter Cornice | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Stay strictly on marked paths in mist or snow; winter snow cornices overhang the eastern cliff edge.

properties.name: Tryfan North Ridge & Bristly Ridge Crags (Ogwen)
properties.plainSummary: Steep rocky peak requiring hands-on climbing; high rate of navigation errors and steep crag falls.
properties.primaryMetric: OVMRO Primary Terrain Cluster | 917m | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Easy to stray onto vertical western gullies in low cloud. Descend only via verified Heather Terrace / Bwlch Tryfan.

properties.name: Twll Du (Devil's Kitchen) & Y Garn Steep Chute
properties.plainSummary: Sheer black cliff gully above Llyn Idwal with loose rock, icefalls, and steep drop-offs.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 800m–947m | Loose Scree & Ice | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Never attempt to climb or descend inside the Devil's Kitchen cleft; follow the stepped stone path to the west.

properties.name: Ysgolion Duon (Black Ladders) Cliff Escarpment
properties.plainSummary: 300m vertical mountain cliff wall in the Carneddau prone to rockfall and winter avalanche.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 1,064m Plateau Edge | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Keep well back from the northern plateau rim in whiteout or high winds.

properties.name: Cadair Idris — Craig Cau & Penygadair North Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Towering glacial amphitheatre cliffs above Llyn Cau with sudden coastal fog and steep drops.
properties.primaryMetric: Aberdyfi SAR Terrain Cluster | 893m | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Rapid sea-fog engulfment causes hikers to walk off northern crags; navigate by compass bearing along ridge.

properties.name: Pen y Fan & Corn Du North Escarpment Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Steep sandstone cliff drop-offs along the northern summit edge of the Brecon Beacons.
properties.primaryMetric: SWMRA Terrain Cluster | 886m | Cornice & Drop Exposure | Penalty: W_incident +5.0
properties.operationalAction: Follow the wide southern ridge path; northern face drops sharply into Cwm Llwch.

properties.name: Llyn Peris & A4086 Valley Flood Zone
properties.plainSummary: Low valley flood and power-surge zone. Climb onto higher ground above Llanberis via Waunfawr.
properties.primaryMetric: Civil Protection Corridor | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: High-voltage surge & reservoir tailrace overflow corridor. Divert above 150m contour via Waunfawr.

properties.name: Conwy Valley Floodplain (Llanrwst to Trefriw)
properties.plainSummary: Valley floor and B5106 flood fast during heavy rain. Use the higher A470 on the east side.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: B5106 & valley floor submerge rapidly during Carneddau storms. Use elevated eastern A470.

properties.name: Afon Glaslyn Gorge Flood Zone (Beddgelert)
properties.plainSummary: Narrow river gorge on the A498 prone to flash flooding and falling rocks in storms.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Narrow gorge bottleneck on A498. Prone to flash river overtopping and rockfall.

properties.name: Afon Dyfi Floodplain (Machynlleth)
properties.plainSummary: A487 bridge approaches flood when high tides meet heavy mountain rain.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Tidal/Fluvial Zone | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: A487 bridge approaches flood during combined high tide and mountain runoff.

properties.name: Pontypridd Taff & Rhondda Flood Zone
properties.plainSummary: Steep valleys funnel fast, deep floodwater onto town roads and the A470 floor.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Spate Flood Zone | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Steep valley walls funnel high-velocity water onto A470/A4058 valley floor.

properties.name: Lower Tywi Floodplain (Llandeilo to Carmarthen)
properties.plainSummary: Wide river valley prone to deep flooding. Keep to the higher A40 ridge road.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Extensive agricultural & road plain inundation. Maintain route along elevated A40 ridge.

properties.name: Ogwen Valley — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: No mobile phone signal or mobile data in this steep valley. Download maps before entering.
properties.operationalAction: Deep glaciated trough blocks mast line-of-sight. Use 2m VHF 145.500 MHz or GB3AR (145.725 MHz).

properties.name: Llanberis Pass — No Mobile Signal

properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Glaciated Slate Gorge | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Zero mobile data or 999 voice inside pass. Climb above 450m ridge or relay via Capel Curig.

properties.name: Rhinogydd & Coed y Brenin — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Wide mountain area with no mobile phone reception across any UK network.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Cambrian Shielding | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Persistent upland shadow across Ardudwy range. Pre-cache offline route before entering.

properties.name: Berwyn Mountains — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Remote high moorland road with zero phone signal and long stretches without shelter.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | High Moorland Defile | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Zero cellular coverage along B4391 pass. Maintain BLE stand-off mesh with convoy.

properties.name: Elan Valley Wilderness — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Large Mid-Wales upland zone with no mobile signal or internet access.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Cambrian Plateau | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Largest continuous cellular shadow in Mid Wales. Rely on offline .pmtiles & VHF simplex.

properties.name: Black Mountain Pass — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Steep hills block mobile phone towers here. Climb to higher ridge ground for signal.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | A4069 & Usk Headwaters | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Steep escarpment blocks South Wales masts. Gain northern ridge crest for line-of-sight.

properties.name: Wenvoe Major TV & Radio Mast

properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 500 kW UHF / VHF | 850m High RF Density Contour

properties.name: Moel-y-Parc TV & Radio Mast
properties.plainSummary: High hilltop broadcast mast with strong line-of-sight across North-East Wales.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Clwydian Range Line-of-Sight Hub
properties.operationalAction: Dominant North-East Wales RF beacon. Elevated ground provides optimal 2m/70cm simplex range.

properties.name: Blaenplwyf Coastal Radio & TV Mast
properties.plainSummary: Major coastal broadcast mast near Aberystwyth; expect strong radio interference close by.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Cardigan Bay Maritime & Broadcast Hub
properties.operationalAction: Primary Mid-Wales coastal transmitter. Expect elevated RF noise floor near perimeter.

properties.name: Llanddona Anglesey Radio & TV Mast

properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Co-located with GB3LL 2m Repeater
properties.operationalAction: Covers Menai Strait, Eryri north coast, and Irish Sea approaches.

properties.name: Halkyn & Clwydian Natural Radon Gas Area

properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: >30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Carboniferous limestone karst releases elevated radon gas. Ventilate basements, caves, or subterranean shelters.

properties.name: Gwynedd Slate Belt Natural Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Rock here can release natural radon gas. Avoid sleeping in unventilated cellars or old mine tunnels.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Fractured metamorphic slate & granite bedrock. Avoid prolonged occupancy in unventilated mine adits or cellars.

properties.name: South Pembrokeshire & Gower Radon Gas Area

properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Coastal limestone fault zone. Ensure active cross-ventilation in ground-level or below-grade shelters.

properties.name: South Wales Valleys Radon Gas Area

properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Deep-mined strata & valley fault lines concentrate soil gas in enclosed lower storeys.

properties.name: Milford Haven / Pembroke Refinery Safety Zone

properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 1,200m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Major hydrocarbon storage & refining facility. Maintain 1.2km upwind clearance during industrial alarms.

properties.name: Barry Docks Chemical Plant Safety Zone
properties.plainSummary: Major chemical site. Stay indoors with windows shut or move cross-wind during alerts.
properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 900m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Silicone & specialty chemical installations. Shelter indoors or evacuate cross-wind if vapour release occurs.

properties.name: Baglan Bay & Port Talbot Industrial Safety Zone
properties.plainSummary: Heavy industrial and gas storage corridor by the M4. Divert inland during chemical alerts.
properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 1,000m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Heavy industrial & energy storage corridor adjacent to M4. Divert inland during hazmat incidents.

properties.name: Deeside & Shotton Power / Gas Safety Zone
properties.plainSummary: Power station and industrial chemical zone on the Dee estuary. Maintain perimeter clearance.
properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 850m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Combined cycle power & chemical manufacturing zone on Dee estuary.

properties.name: Wrexham Industrial Estate Hazmat Buffer
properties.plainSummary: Industrial chemical storage zone. Avoid area if fire or vapour sirens sound.
properties.primaryMetric: Lower-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 750m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Industrial chemical & manufacturing storage buffer. Maintain perimeter clearance.

properties.name: Crib Goch & Garnedd Ugain Knife-Edge Ridge
properties.plainSummary: Exposed Grade 1 knife-edge ridge with 300m sheer drops on both sides. Lethal in high winds or ice.
properties.primaryMetric: MREW High-Frequency Terrain Cluster | 923m–1,085m | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Unroped scrambling with severe fall exposure. Avoid in gusts >30 mph, cloud, or winter verglas; use Llanberis or Ranger path.

properties.name: Yr Wyddfa East Face / Clogwyn y Garnedd Sheer Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Vertical 250m cliff face directly below Snowdon summit & Pyg/Miners upper zig-zags.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 250m Vertical Drop & Winter Cornice | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Stay strictly on marked paths in mist or snow; winter snow cornices overhang the eastern cliff edge.

properties.name: Tryfan North Ridge & Bristly Ridge Crags (Ogwen)
properties.plainSummary: Steep rocky peak requiring hands-on climbing; high rate of navigation errors and steep crag falls.
properties.primaryMetric: OVMRO Primary Terrain Cluster | 917m | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Easy to stray onto vertical western gullies in low cloud. Descend only via verified Heather Terrace / Bwlch Tryfan.

properties.name: Twll Du (Devil's Kitchen) & Y Garn Steep Chute
properties.plainSummary: Sheer black cliff gully above Llyn Idwal with loose rock, icefalls, and steep drop-offs.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 800m–947m | Loose Scree & Ice | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Never attempt to climb or descend inside the Devil's Kitchen cleft; follow the stepped stone path to the west.

properties.name: Ysgolion Duon (Black Ladders) Cliff Escarpment
properties.plainSummary: 300m vertical mountain cliff wall in the Carneddau prone to rockfall and winter avalanche.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 1,064m Plateau Edge | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Keep well back from the northern plateau rim in whiteout or high winds.

properties.name: Cadair Idris — Craig Cau & Penygadair North Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Towering glacial amphitheatre cliffs above Llyn Cau with sudden coastal fog and steep drops.
properties.primaryMetric: Aberdyfi SAR Terrain Cluster | 893m | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Rapid sea-fog engulfment causes hikers to walk off northern crags; navigate by compass bearing along ridge.

properties.name: Pen y Fan & Corn Du North Escarpment Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Steep sandstone cliff drop-offs along the northern summit edge of the Brecon Beacons.
properties.primaryMetric: SWMRA Terrain Cluster | 886m | Cornice & Drop Exposure | Penalty: W_incident +5.0
properties.operationalAction: Follow the wide southern ridge path; northern face drops sharply into Cwm Llwch.

properties.name: Llyn Peris & A4086 Valley Flood Zone
properties.plainSummary: Low valley flood and power-surge zone. Climb onto higher ground above Llanberis via Waunfawr.
properties.primaryMetric: Civil Protection Corridor | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: High-voltage surge & reservoir tailrace overflow corridor. Divert above 150m contour via Waunfawr.

properties.name: Conwy Valley Floodplain (Llanrwst to Trefriw)
properties.plainSummary: Valley floor and B5106 flood fast during heavy rain. Use the higher A470 on the east side.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: B5106 & valley floor submerge rapidly during Carneddau storms. Use elevated eastern A470.

properties.name: Afon Glaslyn Gorge Flood Zone (Beddgelert)
properties.plainSummary: Narrow river gorge on the A498 prone to flash flooding and falling rocks in storms.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Narrow gorge bottleneck on A498. Prone to flash river overtopping and rockfall.

properties.name: Afon Dyfi Floodplain (Machynlleth)
properties.plainSummary: A487 bridge approaches flood when high tides meet heavy mountain rain.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Tidal/Fluvial Zone | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: A487 bridge approaches flood during combined high tide and mountain runoff.

properties.name: Pontypridd Taff & Rhondda Flood Zone
properties.plainSummary: Steep valleys funnel fast, deep floodwater onto town roads and the A470 floor.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Spate Flood Zone | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Steep valley walls funnel high-velocity water onto A470/A4058 valley floor.

properties.name: Lower Tywi Floodplain (Llandeilo to Carmarthen)
properties.plainSummary: Wide river valley prone to deep flooding. Keep to the higher A40 ridge road.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Extensive agricultural & road plain inundation. Maintain route along elevated A40 ridge.

properties.name: Ogwen Valley — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: No mobile phone signal or mobile data in this steep valley. Download maps before entering.
properties.operationalAction: Deep glaciated trough blocks mast line-of-sight. Use 2m VHF 145.500 MHz or GB3AR (145.725 MHz).

properties.name: Llanberis Pass — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: No mobile phone signal or 999 voice reception inside this steep mountain pass.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Glaciated Slate Gorge | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Zero mobile data or 999 voice inside pass. Climb above 450m ridge or relay via Capel Curig.

properties.name: Rhinogydd & Coed y Brenin — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Wide mountain area with no mobile phone reception across any UK network.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Cambrian Shielding | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Persistent upland shadow across Ardudwy range. Pre-cache offline route before entering.

properties.name: Berwyn Mountains — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Remote high moorland road with zero phone signal and long stretches without shelter.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | High Moorland Defile | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Zero cellular coverage along B4391 pass. Maintain BLE stand-off mesh with convoy.

properties.name: Elan Valley Wilderness — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Large Mid-Wales upland zone with no mobile signal or internet access.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Cambrian Plateau | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Largest continuous cellular shadow in Mid Wales. Rely on offline .pmtiles & VHF simplex.

properties.name: Black Mountain Pass — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Steep hills block mobile phone towers here. Climb to higher ridge ground for signal.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | A4069 & Usk Headwaters | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Steep escarpment blocks South Wales masts. Gain northern ridge crest for line-of-sight.

properties.name: Wenvoe Major TV & Radio Mast
properties.plainSummary: High-power broadcast mast. Strong radio signals nearby can interfere with handheld radios.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 500 kW UHF / VHF | 850m High RF Density Contour
properties.operationalAction: Strong local RF field; potential front-end overload on unshielded handheld receivers within 850m.

properties.name: Moel-y-Parc TV & Radio Mast
properties.plainSummary: High hilltop broadcast mast with strong line-of-sight across North-East Wales.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Clwydian Range Line-of-Sight Hub
properties.operationalAction: Dominant North-East Wales RF beacon. Elevated ground provides optimal 2m/70cm simplex range.

properties.name: Blaenplwyf Coastal Radio & TV Mast
properties.plainSummary: Major coastal broadcast mast near Aberystwyth; expect strong radio interference close by.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Cardigan Bay Maritime & Broadcast Hub
properties.operationalAction: Primary Mid-Wales coastal transmitter. Expect elevated RF noise floor near perimeter.

properties.name: Llanddona Anglesey Radio & TV Mast
properties.plainSummary: Major hilltop broadcast mast on Anglesey co-located with emergency radio relay GB3LL.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Co-located with GB3LL 2m Repeater
properties.operationalAction: Covers Menai Strait, Eryri north coast, and Irish Sea approaches.

properties.name: Halkyn & Clwydian Natural Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Natural underground radon gas is high here. Keep basements, caves, and low shelters well ventilated.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: >30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Carboniferous limestone karst releases elevated radon gas. Ventilate basements, caves, or subterranean shelters.

properties.name: Gwynedd Slate Belt Natural Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Rock here can release natural radon gas. Avoid sleeping in unventilated cellars or old mine tunnels.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Fractured metamorphic slate & granite bedrock. Avoid prolonged occupancy in unventilated mine adits or cellars.

properties.name: South Pembrokeshire & Gower Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Elevated natural radon gas in coastal limestone. Keep ground-level shelters well aired.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Coastal limestone fault zone. Ensure active cross-ventilation in ground-level or below-grade shelters.

properties.name: South Wales Valleys Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Underground rock strata can trap natural radon gas in basements and enclosed ground floors.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Deep-mined strata & valley fault lines concentrate soil gas in enclosed lower storeys.

properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: High-Conservation SSSI Zone. No harvesting, uprooting, or disturbance permitted.

properties.name: Elan & Wye Oakwoods (Shelter & Wild Edibles)

properties.name: Wentwood Forest (Shelter & Wild Edibles)

properties.name: Milford Haven / Pembroke Refinery Safety Zone
properties.plainSummary: Major fuel & chemical storage site. Keep 1.2 km upwind if an industrial alarm sounds.
properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 1,200m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Major hydrocarbon storage & refining facility. Maintain 1.2km upwind clearance during industrial alarms.

properties.name: Barry Docks Chemical Plant Safety Zone
properties.plainSummary: Major chemical site. Stay indoors with windows shut or move cross-wind during alerts.
properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 900m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Silicone & specialty chemical installations. Shelter indoors or evacuate cross-wind if vapour release occurs.

properties.name: Baglan Bay & Port Talbot Industrial Safety Zone
properties.plainSummary: Heavy industrial and gas storage corridor by the M4. Divert inland during chemical alerts.
properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 1,000m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Heavy industrial & energy storage corridor adjacent to M4. Divert inland during hazmat incidents.

properties.name: Deeside & Shotton Power / Gas Safety Zone
properties.plainSummary: Power station and industrial chemical zone on the Dee estuary. Maintain perimeter clearance.
properties.primaryMetric: Upper-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 850m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Combined cycle power & chemical manufacturing zone on Dee estuary.

properties.name: Wrexham Industrial Estate Hazmat Buffer
properties.plainSummary: Industrial chemical storage zone. Avoid area if fire or vapour sirens sound.
properties.primaryMetric: Lower-Tier HSE COMAH | Exclusion Buffer: 750m | Penalty: W_comah +8.0
properties.operationalAction: Industrial chemical & manufacturing storage buffer. Maintain perimeter clearance.

properties.name: Crib Goch & Garnedd Ugain Knife-Edge Ridge
properties.plainSummary: Exposed Grade 1 knife-edge ridge with 300m sheer drops on both sides. Lethal in high winds or ice.
properties.primaryMetric: MREW High-Frequency Terrain Cluster | 923m–1,085m | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Unroped scrambling with severe fall exposure. Avoid in gusts >30 mph, cloud, or winter verglas; use Llanberis or Ranger path.

properties.name: Yr Wyddfa East Face / Clogwyn y Garnedd Sheer Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Vertical 250m cliff face directly below Snowdon summit & Pyg/Miners upper zig-zags.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 250m Vertical Drop & Winter Cornice | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Stay strictly on marked paths in mist or snow; winter snow cornices overhang the eastern cliff edge.

properties.name: Tryfan North Ridge & Bristly Ridge Crags (Ogwen)
properties.plainSummary: Steep rocky peak requiring hands-on climbing; high rate of navigation errors and steep crag falls.
properties.primaryMetric: OVMRO Primary Terrain Cluster | 917m | Penalty: W_incident +6.0
properties.operationalAction: Easy to stray onto vertical western gullies in low cloud. Descend only via verified Heather Terrace / Bwlch Tryfan.

properties.name: Twll Du (Devil's Kitchen) & Y Garn Steep Chute
properties.plainSummary: Sheer black cliff gully above Llyn Idwal with loose rock, icefalls, and steep drop-offs.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 800m–947m | Loose Scree & Ice | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Never attempt to climb or descend inside the Devil's Kitchen cleft; follow the stepped stone path to the west.

properties.name: Ysgolion Duon (Black Ladders) Cliff Escarpment
properties.plainSummary: 300m vertical mountain cliff wall in the Carneddau prone to rockfall and winter avalanche.
properties.primaryMetric: OSM natural=cliff | 1,064m Plateau Edge | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Keep well back from the northern plateau rim in whiteout or high winds.

properties.name: Cadair Idris — Craig Cau & Penygadair North Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Towering glacial amphitheatre cliffs above Llyn Cau with sudden coastal fog and steep drops.
properties.primaryMetric: Aberdyfi SAR Terrain Cluster | 893m | Penalty: W_incident +5.5
properties.operationalAction: Rapid sea-fog engulfment causes hikers to walk off northern crags; navigate by compass bearing along ridge.

properties.name: Pen y Fan & Corn Du North Escarpment Cliffs
properties.plainSummary: Steep sandstone cliff drop-offs along the northern summit edge of the Brecon Beacons.
properties.primaryMetric: SWMRA Terrain Cluster | 886m | Cornice & Drop Exposure | Penalty: W_incident +5.0
properties.operationalAction: Follow the wide southern ridge path; northern face drops sharply into Cwm Llwch.

properties.name: Llyn Peris & A4086 Valley Flood Zone
properties.plainSummary: Low valley flood and power-surge zone. Climb onto higher ground above Llanberis via Waunfawr.
properties.primaryMetric: Civil Protection Corridor | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: High-voltage surge & reservoir tailrace overflow corridor. Divert above 150m contour via Waunfawr.

properties.name: Conwy Valley Floodplain (Llanrwst to Trefriw)
properties.plainSummary: Valley floor and B5106 flood fast during heavy rain. Use the higher A470 on the east side.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: B5106 & valley floor submerge rapidly during Carneddau storms. Use elevated eastern A470.

properties.name: Afon Glaslyn Gorge Flood Zone (Beddgelert)
properties.plainSummary: Narrow river gorge on the A498 prone to flash flooding and falling rocks in storms.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Narrow gorge bottleneck on A498. Prone to flash river overtopping and rockfall.

properties.name: Afon Dyfi Floodplain (Machynlleth)
properties.plainSummary: A487 bridge approaches flood when high tides meet heavy mountain rain.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Tidal/Fluvial Zone | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: A487 bridge approaches flood during combined high tide and mountain runoff.

properties.name: Pontypridd Taff & Rhondda Flood Zone
properties.plainSummary: Steep valleys funnel fast, deep floodwater onto town roads and the A470 floor.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Spate Flood Zone | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Steep valley walls funnel high-velocity water onto A470/A4058 valley floor.

properties.name: Lower Tywi Floodplain (Llandeilo to Carmarthen)
properties.plainSummary: Wide river valley prone to deep flooding. Keep to the higher A40 ridge road.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW 1-in-30-Yr Flood Zone 3 | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Extensive agricultural & road plain inundation. Maintain route along elevated A40 ridge.

properties.name: Ogwen Valley — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: No mobile phone signal or mobile data in this steep valley. Download maps before entering.
properties.operationalAction: Deep glaciated trough blocks mast line-of-sight. Use 2m VHF 145.500 MHz or GB3AR (145.725 MHz).

properties.name: Llanberis Pass — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: No mobile phone signal or 999 voice reception inside this steep mountain pass.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Glaciated Slate Gorge | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Zero mobile data or 999 voice inside pass. Climb above 450m ridge or relay via Capel Curig.

properties.name: Rhinogydd & Coed y Brenin — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Wide mountain area with no mobile phone reception across any UK network.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Cambrian Shielding | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Persistent upland shadow across Ardudwy range. Pre-cache offline route before entering.

properties.name: Berwyn Mountains — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Remote high moorland road with zero phone signal and long stretches without shelter.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | High Moorland Defile | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Zero cellular coverage along B4391 pass. Maintain BLE stand-off mesh with convoy.

properties.name: Elan Valley Wilderness — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Large Mid-Wales upland zone with no mobile signal or internet access.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | Cambrian Plateau | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Largest continuous cellular shadow in Mid Wales. Rely on offline .pmtiles & VHF simplex.

properties.name: Black Mountain Pass — No Mobile Signal
properties.plainSummary: Steep hills block mobile phone towers here. Climb to higher ridge ground for signal.
properties.primaryMetric: 4-MNO Blackout | A4069 & Usk Headwaters | Routing Penalty: W_signal +2.5
properties.operationalAction: Steep escarpment blocks South Wales masts. Gain northern ridge crest for line-of-sight.

properties.name: Wenvoe Major TV & Radio Mast
properties.plainSummary: High-power broadcast mast. Strong radio signals nearby can interfere with handheld radios.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 500 kW UHF / VHF | 850m High RF Density Contour
properties.operationalAction: Strong local RF field; potential front-end overload on unshielded handheld receivers within 850m.

properties.name: Moel-y-Parc TV & Radio Mast
properties.plainSummary: High hilltop broadcast mast with strong line-of-sight across North-East Wales.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Clwydian Range Line-of-Sight Hub
properties.operationalAction: Dominant North-East Wales RF beacon. Elevated ground provides optimal 2m/70cm simplex range.

properties.name: Blaenplwyf Coastal Radio & TV Mast
properties.plainSummary: Major coastal broadcast mast near Aberystwyth; expect strong radio interference close by.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Cardigan Bay Maritime & Broadcast Hub
properties.operationalAction: Primary Mid-Wales coastal transmitter. Expect elevated RF noise floor near perimeter.

properties.name: Llanddona Anglesey Radio & TV Mast
properties.plainSummary: Major hilltop broadcast mast on Anglesey co-located with emergency radio relay GB3LL.
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Co-located with GB3LL 2m Repeater
properties.operationalAction: Covers Menai Strait, Eryri north coast, and Irish Sea approaches.

properties.name: Halkyn & Clwydian Natural Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Natural underground radon gas is high here. Keep basements, caves, and low shelters well ventilated.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: >30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Carboniferous limestone karst releases elevated radon gas. Ventilate basements, caves, or subterranean shelters.

properties.name: Gwynedd Slate Belt Natural Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Rock here can release natural radon gas. Avoid sleeping in unventilated cellars or old mine tunnels.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Fractured metamorphic slate & granite bedrock. Avoid prolonged occupancy in unventilated mine adits or cellars.

properties.name: South Pembrokeshire & Gower Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Elevated natural radon gas in coastal limestone. Keep ground-level shelters well aired.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Coastal limestone fault zone. Ensure active cross-ventilation in ground-level or below-grade shelters.

properties.name: South Wales Valleys Radon Gas Area
properties.plainSummary: Underground rock strata can trap natural radon gas in basements and enclosed ground floors.
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Deep-mined strata & valley fault lines concentrate soil gas in enclosed lower storeys.

properties.name: Yr Wyddfa & Cwm Idwal Protected Nature Reserve
properties.plainSummary: Strictly protected wildlife area. Do NOT pick plants, uproot anything, or disturb wildlife here.
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: High-Conservation SSSI Zone. No harvesting, uprooting, or disturbance permitted.

properties.name: Cors Caron Protected Bog Reserve (Tregaron)
properties.plainSummary: Protected deep peat bog. No plant picking allowed — stay strictly on the wooden boardwalks.
properties.primaryMetric: Statutory SSSI & Ramsar Wetland | Wildlife & Countryside Act 1981
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: Protected peatland habitat. Keep strictly to designated raised boardwalks.

properties.name: Gower Cliffs Protected Coastal Reserve
properties.plainSummary: Protected coastal cliff reserve. No plant harvesting or disturbing nesting seabirds.
properties.primaryMetric: Statutory Coastal SSSI | Wildlife & Countryside Act 1981
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: Protected maritime cliff flora and seabird nesting habitat.

properties.name: Coed y Brenin Woodland (Shelter & Wild Edibles)
properties.plainSummary: Dense forest shelter with seasonal berries, nuts, and edible leaves. Never eat wild mushrooms.
properties.primaryMetric: NRW Ancient Semi-Natural Woodland | Theft Act 1968 Compliant
properties.operationalAction: Legal personal-use above-ground flora only (wild garlic, nettles, bilberries, hazelnuts). No uprooting. DO NOT harvest wild fungi/mushrooms.

properties.name: Gwydyr Forest Woodland (Shelter & Wild Edibles)
properties.plainSummary: Good wind shelter, fallen firewood, and seasonal berries/leaves. Never pick wild mushrooms.
properties.primaryMetric: Mixed Broadleaf/Conifer Canopy | Thermal Shelter & Flora
properties.operationalAction: Dense canopy windbreak & fallen deadwood fuel. Personal above-ground foliage/berries only; strictly exclude wild mushrooms.

properties.name: Elan & Wye Oakwoods (Shelter & Wild Edibles)
properties.plainSummary: Oak and hazel woodland with seasonal hazelnuts, blackberries, and sorrel. Never eat wild mushrooms.
properties.primaryMetric: Sessile Oak & Hazel Coppice | Theft Act 1968 Compliant
properties.operationalAction: High seasonal mast (hazelnuts, blackberries, sorrel). Above-ground personal harvest only; zero wild fungi.

properties.name: Wentwood Forest (Shelter & Wild Edibles)
properties.plainSummary: South Wales ancient broadleaf forest with wild garlic, elderberries, and hazel. Never eat wild mushrooms.
properties.primaryMetric: Largest Ancient Woodland in South Wales | Broadleaf Canopy
properties.operationalAction: Rich spring wild garlic, elderflower/elderberry, and hazel. Above-ground personal use only; exclude wild fungi.

properties.name: Carneddau & Glyderau Open Mountain Land
properties.plainSummary: Public right to walk freely off-path across open mountain ground to bypass flooded valleys.
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | Mountain & Moorland
properties.operationalAction: Legal right of foot access across uncultivated upland terrain for high-contour ridge bypasses.

properties.name: Central Brecon Beacons Open Mountain Land
properties.plainSummary: Public right to walk freely off-path across open mountain ridges above valley flood zones.
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | Old Red Sandstone Escarpment
properties.operationalAction: Legal off-trail upland movement zone above valley flood corridors.

properties.name: Preseli Hills Open Moorland
properties.plainSummary: Open moorland with public walking access and clear hilltop range for emergency radios.
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | West Wales Upland Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Open moorland ridge corridor with long-range VHF line-of-sight.

properties.name: Vale of Clwyd Sandstone Groundwater Aquifer
properties.plainSummary: Major underground sandstone water store feeding reliable springs and farm boreholes.
properties.primaryMetric: BGS Principal Permo-Triassic Sandstone Aquifer | High Yield
properties.operationalAction: High-capacity groundwater basin; prioritize spring lines along eastern limestone fault margin.

properties.name: Bannau Brycheiniog Old Red Sandstone Aquifer
properties.plainSummary: Upland sandstone rock layer feeding dozens of clean, cold mountain springs year-round.
properties.primaryMetric: BGS Secondary A / Principal Devonian Sandstone Aquifer
properties.operationalAction: Abundant upland spring discharge along northern escarpment; filter or boil 60s before storage.

properties.name: South Pembrokeshire Carboniferous Limestone Aquifer
properties.plainSummary: Coastal limestone groundwater basin feeding natural springs and wells across South Pembroke.
properties.primaryMetric: BGS Principal Carboniferous Limestone Karst Aquifer
properties.operationalAction: Fast-draining karst aquifer; always filter or boil spring water after heavy agricultural runoff.

properties.name: Rhondda & Taff Valley Steep Slope / Landslide Zone
properties.plainSummary: Steep valley sides prone to mudslides, fallen trees, and road blockages during heavy rain.
properties.primaryMetric: BGS GeoSure High Landslide Susceptibility | Penalty: W_incident +3.0
properties.operationalAction: Glacial till & coal-measure slopes saturate rapidly; watch for debris flows blocking A4058/A4061.

properties.name: Nant Ffrancon & Llyn Ogwen Scree / Rockslide Corridor
properties.plainSummary: Steep mountain cliffs above the A5 prone to rockfalls and scree slides in freeze-thaw weather.
properties.primaryMetric: BGS GeoSure Steep Bedrock / Scree Instability | Penalty: W_incident +3.0
properties.operationalAction: Avoid parking or sheltering directly beneath steep eastern crags during heavy rain or thaw.

properties.name: Ebbw & Sirhowy Valley Steep Escarpment Slip Zone
properties.plainSummary: Steep South Wales valley slopes prone to earthslips and blocked roads after prolonged storms.
properties.primaryMetric: BGS GeoSure High Mass-Movement Zone | Penalty: W_incident +3.0
properties.operationalAction: Monitor valley road embankments for slumping and culvert washouts during named storms.

properties.name: Sennybridge Military Training Area (Restricted Access)
properties.plainSummary: Active military live-firing range. Public entry is strictly prohibited when red flags/lamps are active.
properties.primaryMetric: MoD Statutory Danger Area (SENTA) | OS OpenData Boundary
properties.operationalAction: Do not enter perimeter or touch unexploded ordnance; keep strictly to public A40/B4519 trunk roads.

properties.name: Castlemartin Coastal Firing Range (Restricted Access)
properties.plainSummary: Coastal military live-firing range in South Pembrokeshire. Coastal path closes during firing.
properties.primaryMetric: MoD Statutory Danger Area (Castlemartin) | OS OpenData Boundary
properties.operationalAction: Check range firing notices; divert inland via Warren/St Twynnells when coastal perimeter is closed.

properties.name: Pendine Sands & Test Range (Restricted Access)
properties.plainSummary: Restricted coastal test range and tidal beach danger zone. Obey perimeter warning signs.
properties.primaryMetric: MoD Statutory Danger Area (Pendine) | OS OpenData Boundary
properties.operationalAction: Public access prohibited inside range markers; high-speed tidal surge hazard on adjacent flats.

properties.name: GB3AR - Bangor Mountain Radio Repeater
properties.plainSummary: Backup emergency two-way radio relay with battery power for when mobile networks fail.
properties.primaryMetric: TX: 145.725 MHz | RX: 145.125 MHz | Offset: -0.6 MHz | CTCSS: 103.5 Hz
properties.operationalAction: 2m analog voice repeater (-0.6 MHz shift). Solar + deep-cycle AGM battery backup monitored by North Wales RAYNET.

properties.name: GB3GW - Great Orme Radio Repeater
properties.plainSummary: Coastal emergency two-way radio relay covering Conwy Bay, Llandudno, and Anglesey.
properties.primaryMetric: TX: 433.000 MHz | RX: 434.600 MHz | Offset: +1.6 MHz | CTCSS: 103.5 Hz
properties.operationalAction: 70cm coastal analog voice repeater (+1.6 MHz shift). Long-range line-of-sight across Conwy Bay & Menai Strait.

properties.name: GB3LL - Llanddona Anglesey Radio Repeater

properties.primaryMetric: Telecom / Broadcast Mast | High Ground Line-of-Sight
properties.operationalAction: Most mobile masts have 4–12 hr battery backup before failing in prolonged blackouts.

properties.name: River Glaslyn Flood Gauge (Beddgelert)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks river rise from Snowdon. When high, the A498 valley road floods quickly.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 1.65m | Severe Flood: 2.10m | Basin: Eryri South
properties.operationalAction: Monitors Yr Wyddfa southern runoff. Above 1.65m, A498 Aberglaslyn Pass floods; divert via A4085.

properties.name: River Ogwen Flood Gauge (Bethesda)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks fast mountain runoff that can flood the A5 valley road and bridge.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 1.80m | Severe Flood: 2.40m | Basin: Ogwen
properties.operationalAction: Steep Glyderau/Carneddau catchment; rapid spate surge threatens A5 valley bridge.

properties.name: River Conwy Flood Gauge (Llanrwst)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks fast river flooding at Pont Fawr bridge. Use the higher A470 road in heavy rain.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.40m | Bridge Overtop: 3.10m | Basin: Conwy
properties.operationalAction: Fast-responding Carneddau spate river. Pont Fawr closes early; use eastern A470 high corridor.

properties.name: River Clwyd Flood Gauge (St Asaph)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks river surge at St Asaph bridge that can flood A525 and A55 slip roads.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.20m | Severe Flood: 2.95m | Basin: Clwyd
properties.operationalAction: Flash-flood constriction at Spring Gardens bridge; impacts A525 and A55 slip approaches.

properties.name: River Dee Flood Gauge (Bala / Llyn Tegid)
properties.plainSummary: Monitors lake outflow flooding the Dee valley toward Corwen and Llangollen.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 1.95m | Floodplain Spill: 2.50m | Basin: Upper Dee
properties.operationalAction: Controls Dee valley inundation downstream toward Corwen and Llangollen.

properties.name: River Mawddach Flood Gauge (Ganllwyd)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks mountain river surge that can spill onto the A470 valley road.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 1.90m | A470 Encroachment: 2.45m | Basin: Mawddach
properties.operationalAction: Drains Rhinogydd & Coed y Brenin; A470 valley gorge floods during prolonged orographic rain.

properties.name: River Dyfi Flood Gauge (Machynlleth Bridge)
properties.plainSummary: High river water and high tide here can cut off the main A487 north-south bridge.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.80m | A487 Cut-Off: 3.40m | Basin: Dyfi
properties.operationalAction: Single-corridor A487 north-south artery severs when tidal surge meets spate discharge.

properties.name: River Ystwyth Flood Gauge (Llanilar)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks fast hill runoff that can flood low B4575 river bridges near Aberystwyth.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.05m | Severe Flood: 2.70m | Basin: Ystwyth
properties.operationalAction: Plynlimon runoff corridor; B4575 valley crossings submerge rapidly.

properties.name: River Wye Flood Gauge (Rhayader)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks river surge from the Elan hills along the central A470 corridor.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.10m | Severe Flood: 2.80m | Basin: Upper Wye
properties.operationalAction: Monitors Elan Valley & Cambrian runoff along the central A470 trunk corridor.

properties.name: River Teifi Flood Gauge (Lampeter)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks valley flooding across low A482 and A475 river crossings.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.15m | Severe Flood: 2.85m | Basin: Teifi
properties.operationalAction: Low-lying valley floor inundation risk across A482/A475 river crossings.

properties.name: Western Cleddau Flood Gauge (Haverfordwest)
properties.plainSummary: High river water meeting spring tides can flood town quay roads and bridges.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.35m | Tidal Lock: 3.10m | Basin: Cleddau
properties.operationalAction: Preseli runoff meets Milford Haven spring tide; town quay and A4076 bridges flood.

properties.name: River Tywi Flood Gauge (Carmarthen Quay)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks deep river and tidal flooding across A40 and A484 valley approaches.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 3.20m | Tidal Lock: 4.10m | Basin: Tywi
properties.operationalAction: Wide floodplain inundation across A40/A484 valley approaches during spring tides.

properties.name: River Tawe Flood Gauge (Pontardawe)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks fast river flooding along the A4067 Swansea Valley floor.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.25m | Severe Flood: 3.00m | Basin: Swansea Valley
properties.operationalAction: Drains western Bannau Brycheiniog; A4067 Swansea Valley floor prone to flash inundation.

properties.name: River Neath Flood Gauge (Resolven)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks waterfall valley runoff that can flood low A465 slip roads.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.45m | Severe Flood: 3.20m | Basin: Vale of Neath
properties.operationalAction: Waterfall country spate discharge threatens A465 low-lying slip roads.

properties.name: River Taff Flood Gauge (Pontypridd)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks fast, dangerous flash-flood surges where the Rhondda and Taff rivers meet.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.60m | Severe Flood: 3.50m | Basin: Taff / Rhondda
properties.operationalAction: Confluence bottleneck for Rhondda and Taff valleys; severe urban flash-flood velocity.

properties.name: River Ely Flood Gauge (St Fagans / Cardiff)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks river flooding across low west Cardiff roads and A4232 underpasses.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.15m | Severe Flood: 2.85m | Basin: Ely
properties.operationalAction: Submerges western Cardiff low-lying crossings and A4232 approach culverts.

properties.name: River Usk Flood Gauge (Brecon Bridge)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks Brecon Beacons runoff that quickly floods low town bridges and riverside paths.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.30m | Severe Flood: 3.10m | Basin: Usk
properties.operationalAction: Drains northern Bannau Brycheiniog; low town bridges and riverside roads flood rapidly.

properties.name: River Usk Tidal Barrier (Newport)
properties.plainSummary: Tracks extreme Bristol Channel high tides meeting River Usk floodwater.
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 6.80m AOD | Severe Surge: 7.50m AOD | Basin: Lower Usk
properties.operationalAction: Extreme Bristol Channel tidal range coincides with Usk spate flow.

properties.name: Traeth Lafan Tidal Flats (Llanfairfechan)
properties.plainSummary: Incoming tide fills deep channels behind you faster than walking pace. Check tide times.
properties.primaryMetric: Incoming Tide Velocity: 4+ knots | Routing Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Extensive mudflats flood rapidly from behind via deep channels. Never cross without tide tables.

properties.name: A5 Ogwen Valley Rockfall & Ice Gorge
properties.plainSummary: Narrow mountain gorge prone to falling rocks, fierce crosswinds, and winter black ice.
properties.primaryMetric: DfT STATS19 Cluster | Gale Funnel & Verglas | Penalty: W_incident +4.0
properties.operationalAction: Sheer glaciated slabs above single-carriageway; severe crosswinds and winter verglas.

properties.name: A4086 Pen-y-Pass Steep Mountain Road
properties.plainSummary: Steep 1-in-8 mountain pass with blind crests, freezing fog, and frequent winter ice.
properties.primaryMetric: 1:8 Gradient | Blind Crests & Freezing Fog | Penalty: W_incident +4.0
properties.operationalAction: Impassable in freezing fog/snow; deploy high-visibility markers if evacuating on foot.

properties.name: A470 Crimea Pass (Blaenau Ffestiniog)
properties.plainSummary: High 385m pass that is often the first North Wales main road closed by snowdrifts.
properties.primaryMetric: Elevation: 385m | Snowdrift & Whiteout Corridor | Penalty: W_incident +3.5
properties.operationalAction: Frequently first North Wales trunk pass closed by snowdrifts and freezing cloud.

properties.name: B4391 Milltir Cerrig Pass (Berwyn Hills)
properties.plainSummary: Isolated 486m moorland road with zero phone signal, no shelter, and deep snowdrifts.
properties.primaryMetric: Elevation: 486m | Zero Shelter & Deep Drifts | Penalty: W_incident +3.5
properties.operationalAction: Remote high-moorland pass with zero cellular signal and rapid whiteout exposure.

properties.name: A487 Newgale Beach Storm Surge Road
properties.plainSummary: Storm waves throw heavy stones across this coastal road at high tide. Divert inland.
properties.primaryMetric: Spring Tide + SW Gale Overtopping | Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Storm waves hurl cobbles across A487 coastal causeway; divert inland via Roch/Camrose.

properties.name: Cefn Sidan Sandbar & Quicksand Hazard
properties.plainSummary: Shifting quicksand channels and fast incoming tides cut off outer sandbanks. Stay near dunes.
properties.primaryMetric: 8-Mile Sandbar | Shifting Quicksand Channels | Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Rapid tidal cut-off across outer sandbanks; keep strictly above high-water dune line.

properties.name: Worm's Head Tidal Causeway (Rhossili)
properties.plainSummary: Rocky crossing floods 2.5 hours before high tide and stays underwater for 5 hours.
properties.primaryMetric: Submerged 5 Hours Per Tide Cycle | Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Rocky causeway floods 2.5h before high water; stranding risk with severe Atlantic swell.

properties.name: A4069 Black Mountain Hairpin Pass
properties.plainSummary: Exposed 493m mountain road with sharp hairpins, sheer drops, and severe ice/mist.
properties.primaryMetric: Elevation: 493m | Sheer Drop-Offs & Ice | Penalty: W_incident +4.0
properties.operationalAction: Exposed hairpin mountain road linking Brynaman and Llangadog; hazardous in mist/ice.

properties.name: Sully Island Tidal Causeway
properties.plainSummary: Massive 12m Bristol Channel tides flood this causeway very rapidly. Check tide times.
properties.primaryMetric: Bristol Channel 12m Tidal Surge | Penalty: W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Second-highest tidal range in the world; causeway floods violently on incoming tide.

properties.name: Port Talbot Air Quality & Smoke Sensor
properties.plainSummary: Government air monitor tracking industrial fumes and wildfire smoke levels.
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live UK-AIR AURN Telemetry | PM2.5 & PM10 Particulates
properties.operationalAction: Monitors steelworks, M4 corridor, and Afan valley wildfire smoke particulates.

properties.name: Cardiff Centre Air Quality & Smoke Sensor
properties.plainSummary: Government air monitor tracking city pollution and drifting wildfire smoke.
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live UK-AIR AURN Telemetry | PM2.5 / NO2 / O3
properties.operationalAction: Tracks South-East Wales urban air quality and Bristol Channel smoke drift.

properties.name: Swansea Valley Air Quality & Smoke Sensor
properties.plainSummary: Government air monitor tracking trapped valley smoke and winter smog.
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live UK-AIR AURN Telemetry | PM2.5 & PM10 Particulates
properties.operationalAction: Monitors particulate trapping during winter anticyclonic temperature inversions.

properties.name: Wrexham Air Quality & Smoke Sensor
properties.plainSummary: Government air monitor tracking North-East Wales industrial fumes and moorland wildfire smoke.
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live UK-AIR AURN Telemetry | PM2.5 & PM10 Particulates
properties.operationalAction: Detects Dee Valley inversions and Ruabon/Llantysilio moorland wildfire smoke.

properties.name: Aston Hill Rural Air Quality Sensor (Powys)
properties.plainSummary: Hilltop air monitor tracking regional smoke clouds drifting across Mid Wales.
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live UK-AIR AURN Telemetry | Rural Background PM2.5 / O3
properties.operationalAction: High-elevation rural particulate and ozone sensor tracking regional plume transport.

properties.name: Narberth Rural Air Quality Sensor (Pembrokeshire)
properties.plainSummary: West Wales air monitor tracking coastal wind and Milford Haven industrial air.
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live UK-AIR AURN Telemetry | Maritime Background PM2.5
properties.operationalAction: Monitors Atlantic inflow and Milford Haven industrial corridor downwind particulates.
